rv.q: Families and Disney fans will have a lot of fun with BEAUTY AND THE BEAST.
All in all, Beauty and the Beast remains a heartfelt family musical filled with magical moments.
What is doesn't need are the bloated, interminably long dance numbers that are out of place and unnecessary.
In general, the show’s virtues continue to shine.
Johnson’s Belle exudes gentle, slightly sad openness and spunky kindliness.
Overall, the production was visually stunning and the acting mirrored the movie.

cn.t: Critics praise this enchanting production for bringing Disney's beloved tale to vibrant theatrical life, with elaborate designs, captivating performances, and joyful musical numbers that delight audiences of all ages.
